how to actually understand different subjects
and a few personal tips ౨*ೃ༄˚.༄౨ˊ

Physics
draw the situation before any calculation. arrows, forces, units.
personal tip: if the drawing is right, the formula usually picks itself.

Geography
print a blank map and fill it from memory.
personal tip: do it again 2 days later. what you miss is what to review.

Biology
explain each process out loud, step by step.
personal tip: where you hesitate is exactly the step you don't understand yet.

Philosophy
find one real-life example for every idea.
personal tip: the example is what makes your essay stand out.

Languages
quiz yourself on the week's vocabulary every evening.
personal tip: 10 minutes a day beat my old 2-hour sunday sessions.
